videos.title: Charles Leclerc Breaks His Silence on Online Judgment
videos.description:
Charles Leclerc isn't scared at 230mph. He's terrified watching his younger brother race.

In this clip, Charles Leclerc and Jay Shetty talk about the day he lost his father in 2017, three days before a Formula 2 race in Baku, and the only question he asked himself before getting on the flight.

Charles opens up about the two words his father repeated to him from the age of six, why being harsh with yourself is a strength but putting yourself down isn't, and how you reset your mind in the one second between corners.

Learn about the lie he told his father two days before he passed away, and why it took him a month to make peace with it.

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX
Join 900,000+ readers discovering how small daily shifts create big life change with my free newsletter. Subscribe https://news.jayshetty.me/subscribe

videos.title: My family Grok Bot that allows me to spend more time with my kids
videos.description: Agents built for the home should get you off your computer, not onto it. My design principle for TradBot is a failure state: if I'm spending time with the agent, something is wrong. The kitchen-table newspaper works because it's printed, physical, and sitting next to my kids at breakfast.

videos.title: GPT-6 Astra one-shotted the coding tasks I'd been stuck on for six months
videos.description: Computer use is now good enough to replace my hands on complex node-based UIs, and I'm hands-off my keyboard about 90% of the day. Astra navigated Adio's workflow builder to add new nodes, reconnect logic, and generate custom lead response emails without any clicks from me. I'd given up on this with previous models because the precision just wasn't there.
